# AssistQ
AssistQ is a lead-to-conversion system operated by SonQAI Technologies. It helps businesses capture, qualify, organize, follow up with and understand leads.

Current public plans (verify at checkout):
- Starter: ₹2,999/month; ₹2,299 one-time setup.
- Growth: ₹6,999/month; ₹3,999 one-time setup.
- Premium: ₹11,999/month; ₹4,499 one-time setup.
- Foundation Offer: 15% off the one-time setup fee for the first five clients on each plan while available; monthly pricing is unchanged.
- AI Voice Receptionist: coming soon; not currently sold as part of a paid plan.

Official website: https://www.assistq.in/
Contact: assistq1@gmail.com
